city_tips.title: Use Myki Card for Transit
city_tips.content: Purchase a myki card at Melbourne Airport or major stations for discounted public transport fares.
city_tips.evidence: A myki card. The card is available to purchase and top up with credit at Melbourne Airport, many train stations

city_tips.title: Explore Multicultural Cuisines
city_tips.content: Melbourne's food scene is diverse with world-class restaurants throughout the city.
city_tips.evidence: A large range of restaurants and cafes offering high-quality food, and representing various cultures and countries, are scattered throughout the Central City, Southbank, Carlton

city_tips.title: Visit During Autumn
city_tips.content: March to May offers mild weather perfect for outdoor exploration.
city_tips.evidence: Services generally operate between 5AM and midnight Monday–Saturday and after 8AM Sunday.

city_tips.title: Experience Street Culture
city_tips.content: Melbourne is known for its laneways, arcades and street art.
city_tips.evidence: Trams are a prominent feature in Melbourne's urban landscape and a tourist attraction in themselves.
